Form Dated Chinese currency is 港元…元. Variant P and Variant S specimens remain Form 結算日. Wiki n02 keeps the Form 結算日 specimen and points at this parts page. gc-reference and wiki index Path A rule lines that forbade an explicit date are aligned to the same lock.
